info.description: Retailers featured on nxt.deals, each with its own landing page (/stores/<slug>).

description.description: Markdown. What the store sells, shipping/returns notes, how to use its coupons.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. US, GB, AU.

affiliateNetwork.description: Which programme monetises this store: takeads, amazon-associates, impact, awin, direct…

takeadsSupported.description: Whether Takeads lists this merchant. Off means links go out via affiliateUrl or plain.

commerceMerchantSlug.description: Slug of the matching Commerce · Merchant row, so store pages can also list live offers from the shared product pool.

howToSave.description: Markdown, 150–300 words. The editorial layer that makes this store page ours: how discounts actually work at this retailer, what stacks with what, when it runs its sales. Feed text alone is duplicate content shared with every other publisher.

policies.description: Shopper policy table shown on the store page: { "freeShipping": "Orders $35+", "returns": "30 days", "priceMatch": "Yes — major online retailers", "studentDiscount": "No", "militaryDiscount": "10% in store", "policyUrl": "https://…", "checkedAt": "2026-09-10" }. Every value is a retailer claim an editor checked on the date given; leave a key out rather than guess.

faqs.description: 4–6 store-specific questions ("Does Target accept promo codes?"). Emitted as FAQPage structured data.

takeadsMerchantId.description: Merchant id in the Takeads coupon feed (Takedeals), set by scripts/sync-takedeals.mjs on first match so later runs skip the name lookup.
